challenge.text: A water tank is 3/4 full. Then 1/3 of the water in it is used. What fraction of the whole tank is full now?
hints: Read it again: 1/3 of the water in the tank is used, not 1/3 of the whole tank.
If 1/3 of the water is used, then 2/3 of the water is still there.
You need 2/3 of 3/4. Multiply the two fractions, then simplify your answer.
